title: A Living Stone and a Holy People, Submission to Authority

questions.question: So put away all ____ and all deceit and hypocrisy and envy and all slander.
questions.explanation: 1 Peter 2:1 (ESV): "So put away all malice and all deceit and hypocrisy and envy and all slander."

questions.question: Like newborn infants, long for the pure spiritual ____, that by it you may grow up into salvation—
questions.explanation: 1 Peter 2:2 (ESV): "Like newborn infants, long for the pure spiritual milk, that by it you may grow up into salvation—"

questions.question: if indeed you have tasted that the Lord is ____.
questions.explanation: 1 Peter 2:3 (ESV): "if indeed you have tasted that the Lord is good."

questions.question: As you come to him, a living ____ rejected by men but in the sight of God chosen and precious,
questions.explanation: 1 Peter 2:4 (ESV): "As you come to him, a living stone rejected by men but in the sight of God chosen and precious,"

questions.question: you yourselves like living stones are being built up as a spiritual ____, to be a holy priesthood, to offer spiritual sacrifices acceptable to God through Jesus Christ.
questions.explanation: 1 Peter 2:5 (ESV): "you yourselves like living stones are being built up as a spiritual house, to be a holy priesthood, to offer spiritual sacrifices acceptable to God through Jesus Christ."

questions.question: For it stands in Scripture: "Behold, I am laying in Zion a ____, a cornerstone chosen and precious, and whoever believes in him will not be put to shame."
questions.explanation: 1 Peter 2:6 (ESV): "For it stands in Scripture: 'Behold, I am laying in Zion a stone, a cornerstone chosen and precious, and whoever believes in him will not be put to shame.'"

questions.question: The stone that the builders rejected has become the ____,
questions.explanation: 1 Peter 2:7 (ESV): "So the honor is for you who believe, but for those who do not believe, 'The stone that the builders rejected has become the cornerstone,'"

questions.question: But you are a chosen race, a ____ priesthood, a holy nation, a people for his own possession,
questions.explanation: 1 Peter 2:9 (ESV): "But you are a chosen race, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, a people for his own possession, that you may proclaim the excellencies of him who called you out of darkness into his marvelous light."

questions.question: Once you were not a people, but now you are God's people; once you had not received ____, but now you have received ____.
questions.explanation: 1 Peter 2:10 (ESV): "Once you were not a people, but now you are God's people; once you had not received mercy, but now you have received mercy."

questions.question: Beloved, I urge you as ____ and exiles to abstain from the passions of the flesh, which wage war against your soul.
questions.explanation: 1 Peter 2:11 (ESV): "Beloved, I urge you as sojourners and exiles to abstain from the passions of the flesh, which wage war against your soul."

questions.question: Keep your conduct among the Gentiles ____, so that when they speak against you as evildoers, they may see your good deeds and glorify God on the day of visitation.
questions.explanation: 1 Peter 2:12 (ESV): "Keep your conduct among the Gentiles honorable, so that when they speak against you as evildoers, they may see your good deeds and glorify God on the day of visitation."

questions.question: Be subject for the Lord's sake to every human ____, whether it be to the emperor as supreme,
questions.explanation: 1 Peter 2:13 (ESV): "Be subject for the Lord's sake to every human institution, whether it be to the emperor as supreme,"

questions.question: For this is the will of God, that by doing ____ you should put to silence the ignorance of foolish people.
questions.explanation: 1 Peter 2:15 (ESV): "For this is the will of God, that by doing good you should put to silence the ignorance of foolish people."

questions.question: Honor everyone. Love the brotherhood. Fear ____. Honor the emperor.
questions.explanation: 1 Peter 2:17 (ESV): "Honor everyone. Love the brotherhood. Fear God. Honor the emperor."

questions.question: He himself bore our sins in his body on the tree, that we might die to sin and live to righteousness. By his ____ you have been healed.
questions.explanation: 1 Peter 2:24 (ESV): "He himself bore our sins in his body on the tree, that we might die to sin and live to righteousness. By his wounds you have been healed."

key_verse_text: But you are a chosen race, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, a people for his own possession, that you may proclaim the excellencies of him who called you out of darkness into his marvelous light.
